title: 第5章 七处个个是人才说话又好听第6章 这破烂玩意儿能换钱不
content_zh:
老苏腿一软，差点给这祖宗跪下。
这还得了？
一个开口“你瞅啥”，一个接茬“再瞅一个试试”。
关键是，这俩玩意儿真敢动手啊！
“好汉！好汉！有话好说！别动手！”老苏立马换了副嘴脸，满脸堆笑。
他心里把自己那个不当人的表弟江听洲骂了十八遍。
要不是亲戚关系，同个祖宗，他都想骂他十八代祖宗了。
坑货！
绝对是坑货！
把我往火坑里推！
“咳，开个玩笑，苏处长别当真。”陈邪摆了摆手，见好就收。
他就是恶趣味上来，吓唬吓唬这大叔。
老苏擦了擦额头不存在的冷汗，长舒一口气。
“陈……陈邪是吧？走，我带你去咱们七处看看。”
老苏在前面带路，走得小心翼翼，生怕哪一步踩错了，后面这位爷不高兴，直接把他炼了。
他心里苦啊。
我这是造了什么孽啊！
好端端的摸鱼日子，怎么就摊上这么个活祖宗了！
来到四楼，两人一鹅穿过长长的走廊，来到一扇厚重的合金门前。
老苏把手按在门旁的识别器上。

“滴——身份确认，苏生。”
合金门无声地向两侧滑开。
门后的景象，让陈邪愣了一下。
这里没有办公室的样子，倒像个会所。真皮沙发、吧台、游戏机、家庭影院……应有尽有。
陈邪心里冒出两个字：腐败！
不过，我喜欢！
“苏哥，回来啦？”
一个懒洋洋的声音从沙发那边传来。
陈邪看过去，只见一个穿着骚包花衬衫，长相俊美的男人正躺在沙发上，一边敷着面膜，一边拿着个小镜子左右端详。
男人看到陈邪，眼睛一亮，直接从沙发上坐了起来。
“呦，苏哥，哪拐来的小帅哥？介绍介绍呗。”
男人声音很有磁性，一双桃花眼冲他眨了眨。
陈邪浑身一哆嗦。
好家伙，这哥们儿有点东西。
这颜值，连他都得承认，确实帅得掉渣。
“去去去，没个正形。”老苏没好气地摆了摆手，“这是新来的同事，陈邪。”
他又指着那花衬衫帅哥，对陈邪介绍：“萧逸，阵宗出来的，咱们七处的阵法师，筑基巅峰。别看他娘们唧唧的，布阵的本事还行。”
阵宗，大夏官方背书的顶级宗门之一，一手阵法通天彻地。
“什么叫娘们唧唧的，我这叫精致。”萧逸不乐意了，对着陈邪抛了个媚眼。
陈邪：“……”

他感觉自己的拳头有点硬了。
content_en:
Old Su's legs went weak and he almost knelt down in front of this ancestor.
Is this okay?
One said, "What are you looking at?" and the other said, "Take another look and try."
The key is, these two things really dare to do it!
"A good man! A good man! You have something to say! Don't do anything!" Lao Su immediately changed his face, with a smile on his face.
In his mind, he scolded his ungrateful cousin Jiang Tingzhou eighteen times.
If it weren't for the relationship and the same ancestor, he would have wanted to scold him as his eighteenth generation ancestor.
What a scam!
It’s definitely a scam!
Push me into the fire pit!
"Ahem, it's just a joke. Director Su, don't take it seriously." Chen Xie waved his hand and let it go.
He just came up with a bad intention to scare this uncle.
Lao Su wiped the non-existent cold sweat from his forehead and breathed a sigh of relief.
"Chen...Chen Xie, right? Come on, I'll take you to visit our seventh office."
Lao Su led the way, walking cautiously, for fear that if he took a wrong step, the man behind him would be unhappy and directly beat him.
He felt miserable.
What evil have I done!
How could such a good fishing life end up with such a living ancestor!
Arriving on the fourth floor, the two of them walked through the long corridor and came to a heavy alloy door.
Lao Su pressed his hand on the identifier next to the door.
"Di - identity confirmed, Su Sheng."
The alloy door slid open to both sides silently.
The scene behind the door stunned Chen Xie for a moment.
It doesn't look like an office here, but more like a club. Leather sofas, bar counters, game consoles, home theaters... everything is available.
Two words came to Chen Xie's mind: corruption!
However, I like it!
"Brother Su, are you back?"
A lazy voice came from the sofa.
Chen Xie looked over and saw a handsome man wearing a floral shirt lying on the sofa, applying a facial mask and looking around in a small mirror.
When the man saw Chen Xie, his eyes lit up and he sat up from the sofa.
"Hey, Brother Su, where did you kidnap this handsome guy? Let me introduce him."
The man's voice was very magnetic, and his peach blossom eyes blinked at him.
Chen Xie shivered all over.
Boy, this guy has something.
Even he had to admit that he was indeed extremely handsome.
"Go, go, no formality." Lao Su waved his hand angrily, "This is a new colleague, Chen Xie."
He then pointed at the handsome guy in the floral shirt and introduced to Chen Xie: "Xiao Yi, from the Formation Sect, our Formation Master of the Seventh Division, at the pinnacle of foundation building. Don't look at his bitch, his ability to set up formations is pretty good."
The Formation Sect, one of the top sects officially endorsed by the Great Xia, has a mastery of formation techniques that can penetrate the heavens and the earth.
"What do you call a girl's chirping? I call this exquisite." Xiao Yi was unhappy and gave Chen Xie a wink.
Chen Xie: "..."
He felt that his fist was a little hard.
